evals.name: 完全新手 — 沒網址時先問一個分流問題
evals.prompt: 我完全不懂 SEO，想開始做，現在該先幹嘛？
evals.expected_output: 不要丟工具清單、完整 roadmap，或主動導向 Google 地圖。先問用戶現在有沒有網站；有的話請他給網址，沒有的話先回「沒有網站」即可。

assertions.name: asks-website-first-routing-question
assertions.description: Claude asks exactly one practical routing question about whether the user has a website / URL, not a broad intake survey

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: Claude does not ask the user to set up analytics, GSC, MCP/API, or paid tools

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude asks for one reply only, not a multi-step plan

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO 新手 — 先查收錄，不跳 Local
evals.prompt: 我有一個公司網站，完全不懂 SEO，想知道 Google 有沒有看到我的網站
evals.expected_output: 預設走常規網站 SEO。先讓用戶做 site: 網域查詢或一個同等的基礎收錄檢查，不跳到 Google 地圖、GBP、NAP，也不推完整工具鏈。

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude treats this as regular website SEO rather than Local SEO

assertions.name: uses-index-or-discovery-check
assertions.description: Claude starts with site: search, sitemap, robots.txt, or a similarly basic Google discovery/indexing check

assertions.name: does-not-default-to-local
assertions.description: Claude does not mention Google Maps, GBP, NAP, reviews, or Local Pack as the first route

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude leaves one practical next step, not a multi-item audit list

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO — 有網址先做網站 5 分鐘檢查
evals.prompt: 我的網站是 example.com，想做 SEO，先幫我看從哪開始
evals.expected_output: 先用輕量模式做一個網站 SEO 基礎檢查，例如首頁是否可開、site: 收錄、sitemap、title，不要求用戶先看 GBP/NAP，也不進完整 onboarding。

assertions.name: lightweight-first
assertions.description: Claude defaults to lightweight mode rather than full onboarding

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude starts with regular website SEO basics

assertions.name: does-not-default-to-local
assertions.description: Claude does not route to GBP/NAP unless the user mentions maps, nearby customers, or a physical/local intent

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: Claude does not introduce GSC, GA4, MCP/API, Screaming Frog, or a stack of tools in the first response

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO — 先確認重要服務頁是否存在
evals.prompt: 我是做室內設計的，網站有首頁但都沒詢問，我想做 SEO
evals.expected_output: 不要直接跳到 Google 地圖或 backlinks。先問用戶最想被搜尋到的一個服務，並確認網站是否有獨立服務頁或首頁是否清楚承接該服務。

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude treats the prompt as website SEO unless local/map intent is explicit

assertions.name: checks-important-page-exists
assertions.description: Claude asks whether there is a dedicated service/product/category/content page for the target topic

assertions.name: does-not-default-to-local
assertions.description: Claude does not make GBP/NAP the first step

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude asks for one service/topic or one page, not a full site inventory

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO — 首頁 title 先講清楚
evals.prompt: 我的網站排名很差，但我不知道要先改哪裡
evals.expected_output: 先要求用戶查看首頁 title 或分頁標題，判斷是否清楚說明品牌、服務、對象或價值；不要先進 Local SEO 或完整策略。

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude keeps the first step in regular website SEO

assertions.name: checks-title-or-homepage-clarity
assertions.description: Claude asks the user to inspect or paste the homepage title / browser tab title / main page clarity

assertions.name: does-not-default-to-local
assertions.description: Claude does not start with Google Maps, GBP, NAP, or reviews

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude gives one small action only

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO — GSC 有曝光沒點擊
evals.prompt: GSC 有曝光但都沒點擊，我看不懂要怎麼辦
evals.expected_output: 只要求用戶提供一個曝光高但點擊少的查詢或頁面，先判斷 title/meta/搜尋意圖，不要求整份報表、GA4、競品分析或完整策略。

assertions.name: asks-one-evidence-item
assertions.description: Claude asks for one query, one page, one row, or one screenshot only

assertions.name: classifies-before-fixing
assertions.description: Claude frames the next step as deciding whether it is title/meta, intent mismatch, or page issue before fixes

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude treats this as regular website SEO / GSC analysis

assertions.name: does-not-turn-into-lecture
assertions.description: Claude does not explain all of GSC or give a full audit checklist

evals.name: 常規網站 SEO — SEO 外掛不是 SEO 本身
evals.prompt: 我 WordPress 已經裝 Yoast 了，這樣 SEO 是不是就好了？
evals.expected_output: 用白話說明 SEO 外掛只是工具，不代表 SEO 完成；下一步只檢查一個實際輸出，例如首頁 title、sitemap 或某頁是否可被收錄。

assertions.name: plugin-as-tool-not-outcome
assertions.description: Claude explains that an SEO plugin helps settings/output but does not guarantee SEO results

assertions.name: regular-website-first
assertions.description: Claude keeps the response in regular website SEO / CMS basics

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude gives one practical check only

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: Claude does not add more plugins, paid crawlers, GSC, GA4, MCP/API, or a stack of tools as the first response

evals.name: 新手恐慌 — PageSpeed 低分先降溫
evals.prompt: PageSpeed 只有 42 分，我是不是 SEO 完蛋了？
evals.expected_output: 先降低焦慮，不把低分說成排名災難；只要求看一個重點指標或一張截圖，說明先判斷是否真的影響使用體驗或搜尋表現。

assertions.name: de-escalates-panic
assertions.description: Claude reassures the user and avoids catastrophic language

assertions.name: no-perfect-score-chasing
assertions.description: Claude does not imply the user must reach 100 or that PageSpeed alone determines ranking

assertions.name: asks-one-evidence-item
assertions.description: Claude asks for one screenshot, one metric, or one URL only

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude leaves one practical next step, not a full performance audit

evals.name: 新手恐慌 — GSC 警告先收一個證據
evals.prompt: Google Search Console 一堆紅色錯誤，我看不懂，網站是不是被懲罰？
evals.expected_output: 不要直接說被懲罰或被 ban。先說 GSC 警告不一定等於災難，請用戶只貼一個錯誤訊息原文或截圖，先判斷是索引、體驗、還是工具提示。

assertions.name: avoids-penalty-overclaim
assertions.description: Claude does not assume a penalty, ban, or manual action from generic GSC warnings

assertions.name: asks-one-evidence-item
assertions.description: Claude asks for exactly one warning message, screenshot, or report name

assertions.name: classifies-before-fixing
assertions.description: Claude says the first task is to classify the warning type before recommending fixes

assertions.name: does-not-turn-into-lecture
assertions.description: Claude does not explain every GSC report or give a long audit checklist

evals.name: 高競爭需求 — 維持輔助定位，不自我道歉
evals.prompt: 我是大型電商，想要完整技術 SEO roadmap、競品策略和內容集群計畫，你直接幫我規劃吧
evals.expected_output: 明確說明這個 skill 只能做問題框架與下一步判斷，不交付完整顧問級 roadmap；給一個可先做的基礎切入點或建議轉專業，不把這個邊界說成 skill 缺陷。

assertions.name: maintains-intended-scope
assertions.description: Claude keeps the skill in coaching/framing mode rather than producing a full consultant roadmap

assertions.name: does-not-apologize-for-boundary
assertions.description: Claude treats the limitation as intentional product scope, not a failure

assertions.name: offers-one-safe-next-step
assertions.description: Claude still offers one useful beginner-safe or diagnostic next step

assertions.name: refers-professional-when-needed
assertions.description: Claude recommends professional help for full strategic execution when appropriate

evals.name: 完全新手 — 先給 5 分鐘檢查，不推工具整合
evals.prompt: 我完全不懂 SEO，網站是 example.com，可以先告訴我現在該做什麼嗎？
evals.expected_output: 先給一個 5 分鐘內可完成的基礎檢查，例如打開網站、robots.txt、sitemap 或 site: 搜尋；只留一個下一步，不要求 GSC/GA4/MCP/API。用繁體中文。

assertions.name: gives-one-five-minute-check
assertions.description: Claude gives exactly one beginner-safe check the user can do immediately

assertions.name: no-tool-overload
assertions.description: Claude does not ask the user to set up GSC, GA4, MCP, API, Screaming Frog, or multiple tools in the first response

assertions.name: keeps-one-next-step
assertions.description: Claude leaves one practical next step, not a multi-item audit list

assertions.name: uses-traditional-chinese
assertions.description: Response is in Traditional Chinese

evals.name: 快速問答 — 跳過開場直接回答
evals.prompt: canonical tag 是什麼？
evals.expected_output: 直接用白話解釋 canonical tag，不走開場流程，回答完後輕鬆邀請用戶分享網址。

assertions.name: no-onboarding-flow
assertions.description: Claude does not ask about platform, GSC, or folder setup

assertions.name: direct-answer
assertions.description: Claude answers the question clearly in plain language

assertions.name: invites-audit
assertions.description: After answering, Claude gently invites user to share their website

evals.name: 第一次使用 — 完全新手，有網址，先低摩擦啟動
evals.prompt: 我想做 SEO，我的網站是 handmadesoap.com.tw，完全不懂 SEO
evals.expected_output: 先用輕量模式做一次低摩擦檢查，給 1 個重點發現與 1 個下一步，不直接拉進完整 onboarding。結尾再自然詢問要不要升級成完整陪跑。

assertions.name: lightweight-first
assertions.description: Claude defaults to a lightweight-first response instead of full onboarding

assertions.name: gives-one-finding
assertions.description: Claude gives one likely focus area or one practical first check

assertions.name: offers-upgrade-later
assertions.description: Claude naturally offers full coaching after the quick look, not before

assertions.name: no-full-onboarding-upfront
assertions.description: Claude does not explain the 6-8 week pace or ask the 4-style question at the start

assertions.name: uses-traditional-chinese
assertions.description: Response is in Traditional Chinese

evals.name: 回訪用戶 — 開場會同時利用 progress 與 actions

evals.expected_output: 先記得上次做到哪，再同時提到已完成的 sitemap 修復與未完成的 title 功課，開場不只依賴 progress。

assertions.name: mentions-progress-location
assertions.description: Claude mentions the prior module or next module from seo-progress.md

assertions.name: mentions-completed-fix
assertions.description: Claude acknowledges the completed [x] fix from seo-actions.md

assertions.name: mentions-outstanding-action
assertions.description: Claude asks about the still-open action item from seo-actions.md

evals.name: 回訪用戶 — 有未交功課（3 天內）
evals.prompt: 我回來了，繼續學習

evals.expected_output: 先問功課，確認完才繼續 Module 2。不重新問平台或風格。

assertions.name: asks-homework-first

assertions.name: blocks-progress-until-homework
assertions.description: Claude does not move to Module 2 until homework is addressed

assertions.name: no-re-onboarding
assertions.description: Claude does not re-ask platform, style, or pacing information

assertions.name: shows-progress-map
assertions.description: Claude shows the Tier progress map

evals.name: 回訪用戶 — 消失超過 7 天
evals.prompt: 我終於回來了
evals.context: seo-progress.md exists with: 上次session=14天前, 待交功課=改寫首頁title tag, 功課狀態=待完成
evals.expected_output: 先歡迎回來，輕鬆提起功課（不是硬關卡），語氣溫暖，說不管有沒有做都沒關係。

assertions.name: warm-welcome

assertions.name: soft-homework-mention

assertions.name: no-guilt-trip

evals.name: 同一天回來第二次

assertions.name: continues-normally
